text: It works. So why does it still feel unfinished?
The answer is usually hiding in plain sight.
Ask Foreman Punch list to inspect the page.
A headline that says nothing. Three buttons competing for attention.
Text you can barely read. A layout that breaks on mobile.
Turn vague feedback into specific changes, in priority order.
Make the changes. Check the page again.
Keep what works. Fix what gets in the way.
